sourceStyleProfile.style: Stylized three-dimensional rendering with warm soft cinematic sunlight, physically shaded worn copper and green metal, rounded forms, amber glowing eyes, mossy wooden planters, shallow depth of field and blurred greenhouse foliage.
sourceStyleProfile.content: A small rounded copper and green robot holds a metal watering can in one hand and stands among wooden planters in a lush greenhouse. It has a domed head with two antennae, a black faceplate with two circular glowing amber eyes, riveted joints and broad boots. Warm sunlight filters through greenhouse windows.
